title: Known Reference Cards
check_scope: Pass/fail validation checks for known controls and negative controls; not evidence ranks and never mixed with candidate feasibility bands.
red_team_self_audit: Known actuals are post-hoc checks and are not used to generate unknown candidates or assign feasibility bands.
Known-control checks are not candidate evidence ranks.
F160 black is held as a source-conflict check and receives no known-answer recovery credit until authoritative /38B or NAVSEA/DLA confirmation.
F161 full-BOM checks disclose VS residuals as variance, not top recovery proof.
Partial-TDS anchors are visibly marked class checks and cannot receive full-BOM recovery credit.
Negative controls are expected-rejection checks and carry no recovery score.

source_conflict.status: OPEN - source conflict pending authoritative /38B or NAVSEA/DLA confirmation
source_conflict.issue: The public /38A Formula 160 black record and extracted table structure do not by themselves close the Component-B epoxy_resin/silica assignment with enough authority for known-answer recovery credit.
source_conflict.physical_reconciliation: Epoxy 709 lb / silica 62 lb reconciles Component-B density near the reported 10.2-10.6 lb/gal range and gives a plausible epoxy-rich vehicle; the reversed reading gives an implausibly high density and stoichiometry. This is a provisional physical reconciliation, not an authoritative correction.
source_conflict.formula_161_comparison: Formula 161 /39B yellow shows the same base architecture with yellow iron oxide replacing black iron oxide; it supports the reconciliation but does not resolve the /38A black authority conflict.
source_conflict.claim_limit: Do not use Formula 160 black for strong known-answer recovery, qualification, or exact-reproduction claims until an authoritative /38B or NAVSEA/DLA-confirmed source closes the conflict.
